::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/api_keys"}
#docs
## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The api key's id (key_…). |
| `data.name` | `string` | The key's name. |
| `data.prefix` | `string` | The first characters of the key, so you can recognize it. The full key is shown only once, when you create it. |
| `data.livemode` | `string` | `live` for a live key, `test` for a test key. One of `test`, `live`, `all`. |
| `data.scope` | `string` | What the key can do: `read` or `write`. One of `read`, `write`. |
| `data.secret` | `string` | Returned once at creation only. |
| `data.last_used_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the key was last used (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the api key was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.revoked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the key was revoked (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `data.expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the key stops working (ISO-8601 UTC), or null if it never expires. |
| `data.permissions` | `object` | The key's permission map. Null: the key works by its scope. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/api_keys" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "api_key",
      "id": "key_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
      "prefix": "sk_test_AbCd",
      "livemode": "test"
    }
  ]
}
```
